Great service, good food, reasonable price
Jun 2017 • Family
We had breakfast in S'Ngon twice and lunch once. The breakfast was good. It offered cook-to-order noodles and eggs. The variety of fruit, dessert and bread was wider than some 4-star hotels. The Vietnamese lunch sets were reasonably priced and of excellent quality. Yet, what urges me to write this review is the excellent service in this restaurant. The staff was so very nice that we enjoyed each meal in this restaurant. They were genuinely hospitable and helpful. The banh xeo was the best we had in Da Nang and Hoi An.
